name: use-tags
title: useTagInput
description: useTagInput: the tags block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the tags block (`npx better-supabase add tags`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/tags.
